name: @loom/runbook-recall
description: Knowledge retrieval (RAG) over a corpus that CHANGES: a semantic memory tier as the corpus, @loom/knowledge for the document-to-passage mapping (upsert, sync, citations), ctx.decide to make the retrieval a recorded fact, and the ADR-0085 taint that refuses a retrieved passage in an instruction position. No knowledge$ construct, no embedding SPI, no kernel change. Headless.
